expectations.text: Output analyzes duplication between CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md or other documentation files
expectations.evidence: Section 3 (DUP-01 through DUP-06) extensively analyzes duplication across documentation files. DUP-05 specifically identifies that project metrics appear in CLAUDE.md plus 3 other files (README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE_v1.md) and are out of sync. DUP-04 compares MASTER_PLAN.md vs docs/IDEAL_MASTER_PLAN.md. DUP-03 compares IMPROVEMENT_MASTER_PLAN v1 vs v2. Section 6 further lists 15 files in docs/ not registered in CLAUDE.md. Note: MEMORY.md does not appear to exist in this project — the output correctly identifies duplication between CLAUDE.md and other docs instead.

expectations.text: Output checks ISSUES.md for stale or incorrectly-open entries
expectations.evidence: Section 5 (ISSUES.md — оценка актуальности) explicitly checks ISSUES.md. It identifies 6 open issues: DB-01 assessed as likely still valid, and SEN-01..05 flagged as potentially stale (8 days since creation, no updates visible). The output notes that per project protocol, items open >7 days warrant review. The metrics.json also records 'open_issues_in_issues_md': 6 with days_since_creation tracked per entry. OC-08 also flags AUDIT_2026-03-03.md as marked АКТУАЛЕН but >7 days old per project rules.

expectations.text: Output validates file path references mentioned in CLAUDE.md
expectations.evidence: Section 1 (BL-01, BL-02) explicitly checks file existence for paths referenced in CLAUDE.md and other docs. BL-01 identifies that docs/DESIGN_DECISIONS_v1.md is referenced in README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE_v1.md but does not physically exist. Section 2 (OC-06) validates that CLAUDE.md line 26 references docs/IMPROVEMENT_MASTER_PLAN.md (v1) but that document is closed and v2 is the current one. Section 6 cross-validates files in docs/ against what CLAUDE.md's architecture tree lists, finding 15 unregistered files. The metrics.json confirms broken_links count of 1 with file path details.

claims: 15 docs in docs/ not registered in CLAUDE.md
Server IP 34.107.127.155 in public MD files (acceptable for private repo)

suggestions: The output does not explicitly mention MEMORY.md by name — it correctly handles the case where MEMORY.md does not exist and pivots to analyzing CLAUDE.md vs other docs, which is appropriate
ISSUES.md staleness check could be more decisive — the output hedges with 'unknown' for SEN-01..05 rather than clearly flagging them as requiring update given the 8-day age
File path validation is thorough for CLAUDE.md references to docs/, but could also check references within the docs tree itself more systematically
The output quality is high: structured sections, evidence with line numbers, prioritized recommendations, and machine-readable metrics.json
eval_feedback.overall: All three expectations are fully met. The output performs a comprehensive documentation audit covering: (1) duplication analysis across CLAUDE.md and other docs with 6 identified duplicate groups; (2) ISSUES.md staleness check identifying 6 open issues, 5 of which are flagged as potentially stale at 8 days; (3) file path validation finding 1 broken link and 15 unregistered docs. The audit is well-structured with severity ratings, specific line references, and actionable recommendations.
